Awake.description: Awake is called when the script instance is being loaded.

FixedUpdate.description: This function is called every fixed framerate frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

LateUpdate.description: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled.

OnAnimatorIK.description: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

OnAnimatorMove.description: Callback for processing animation movements for modifying root motion.

OnApplicationFocus.description: Callback sent to all game objects when the player gets or loses focus.

OnApplicationPause.description: Callback sent to all game objects when the player pauses.

OnApplicationQuit.description: Callback sent to all game objects before the application is quit.

OnAudioFilterRead.description: If OnAudioFilterRead is implemented, Unity will insert a custom filter into the audio DSP chain.

OnBecameInvisible.description: OnBecameInvisible is called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

OnBecameVisible.description: OnBecameVisible is called when the renderer became visible by any camera.

OnCollisionEnter.description: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

OnCollisionEnter2D.description: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

OnCollisionExit.description: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

OnCollisionExit2D.description: Sent when a collider on another object stops touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

OnCollisionStay.description: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching rigidbody/collider.

OnCollisionStay2D.description: Sent each frame where a collider on another object is touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

OnControllerColliderHit.description: OnControllerColliderHit is called when the controller hits a collider while performing a Move.

OnDestroy.description: This function is called when the MonoBehaviour will be destroyed.

OnDisable.description: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled or inactive.

OnDrawGizmos.description: Callback to draw gizmos that are pickable and always drawn.

OnDrawGizmosSelected.description: Callback to draw gizmos only if the object is selected.

OnEnable.description: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

OnGUI.description: OnGUI is called for rendering and handling GUI events.

OnJointBreak.description: Called when a joint attached to the same game object broke.

OnJointBreak2D.description: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same game object breaks.

OnMouseDown.description: OnMouseDown is called when the user has pressed the mouse button while over the GUIElement or Collider.

OnMouseDrag.description: OnMouseDrag is called when the user has clicked on a GUIElement or Collider and is still holding down the mouse.

OnMouseEnter.description: Called when the mouse enters the GUIElement or Collider.

OnMouseExit.description: Called when the mouse is not any longer over the GUIElement or Collider.

OnMouseOver.description: Called every frame while the mouse is over the GUIElement or Collider.

OnMouseUp.description: OnMouseUp is called when the user has released the mouse button.

OnMouseUpAsButton.description: OnMouseUpAsButton is only called when the mouse is released over the same GUIElement or Collider as it was pressed.

OnParticleCollision.description: OnParticleCollision is called when a particle hits a collider.

OnParticleSystemStopped.description: OnParticleSystemStopped is called when all particles in the system have died.

OnParticleTrigger.description: OnParticleTrigger is called when any particles in a particle system meet the conditions in the trigger module.

OnPostRender.description: OnPostRender is called after a camera finishes rendering the scene.

OnPreCull.description: OnPreCull is called before a camera culls the scene.

OnPreRender.description: OnPreRender is called before a camera starts rendering the scene.

body: private void OnRenderImage(RenderTexture src, RenderTexture dest)
OnRenderImage.description: OnRenderImage is called after all rendering is complete to render image.

OnRenderObject.description: OnRenderObject is called after camera has rendered the scene.

OnTransformChildrenChanged.description: Called when the list of children of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

OnTransformParentChanged.description: Called when the parent property of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

OnTriggerEnter.description: OnTriggerEnter is called when the Collider other enters the trigger.

OnTriggerEnter2D.description: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

OnTriggerExit.description: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

OnTriggerExit2D.description: Sent when another object leaves a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

OnTriggerStay.description: OnTriggerStay is called once per frame for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

OnTriggerStay2D.description: Sent each frame where another object is within a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

OnValidate.description: Called when the script is loaded or a value is changed in the inspector (Called in the editor only).

OnWillRenderObject.description: OnWillRenderObject is called for each camera if the object is visible.

Reset.description: Reset is called when the user hits the Reset button in the Inspector's context menu.

Start.description: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods is called the first time.

Update.description: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

OnSelectionChange.description: Called whenever the selection has changed.
